options.name: apps
options.description: A list of space-delimited apps to target. Used by the V(test) command.

options.name: cache_table
options.description: The name of the table used for database-backed caching. Used by the V(createcachetable) command.

options.name: clear
options.description: Clear the existing files before trying to copy or link the original file. Used only with the V(collectstatic) command. The C(--noinput) argument is added automatically.

options.name: command
options.description: The name of the Django management command to run. The commands listed below are built in this module and have some basic parameter validation. V(collectstatic) - Collects the static files into C(STATIC_ROOT). V(createcachetable) - Creates the cache tables for use with the database cache backend. V(flush) - Removes all data from the database. V(loaddata) - Searches for and loads the contents of the named O(fixtures) into the database. V(migrate) - Synchronizes the database state with models and m

options.name: database
options.description: The database to target. Used by the V(createcachetable), V(flush), V(loaddata), V(syncdb), and V(migrate) commands.

options.name: failfast
options.description: Fail the command immediately if a test fails. Used by the V(test) command.

options.name: fixtures
options.description: A space-delimited list of fixture file names to load in the database. B(Required) by the V(loaddata) command.

options.name: link
options.description: Creates links to the files instead of copying them, you can only use this parameter with V(collectstatic) command.

options.name: merge
options.description: Runs out-of-order or missing migrations as they are not rollback migrations, you can only use this parameter with V(migrate) command.

options.name: project_path
options.description: The path to the root of the Django application where C(manage.py) lives.

options.name: pythonpath
options.description: A directory to add to the Python path. Typically used to include the settings module if it is located external to the application directory. This would be equivalent to adding O(pythonpath)'s value to the E(PYTHONPATH) environment variable.

options.name: settings
options.description: The Python path to the application's settings module, such as V(myapp.settings).

options.name: skip
options.description: Skips over out-of-order missing migrations, you can only use this parameter with V(migrate) command.

options.name: testrunner
options.description: Controls the test runner class that is used to execute tests. This parameter is passed as-is to C(manage.py).

options.name: virtualenv
options.description: An optional path to a C(virtualenv) installation to use while running the manage application. The virtual environment must exist, otherwise the module fails.
